text:
maya: Need a tiny probe run for the launch post — 250 queries, focused smoke + variance probe. Target deliverables in 48h.

ajay: Got it. list the exact artifacts and success criteria so runtime can validate.

maya: Artifacts: per-request CSV (latency_ms, tokens_in, tokens_out, model_tag), aggregate metrics (p50/p90/p99), warmup vs coldstart delta heatmap, runner_cmd.txt, small README with seed file link. Success: no >1% errors and p99 within expected range.

sophia: Please embed the seed CSV link and exact model tags. Also request one quantized trial if available; well footnote regressions.

maya: Seed: https://redwood.co/samples/launch-mini-250.csv. Use model tag rw-large-v1:2026-03-10. Quantized try: rw-large-v1-q4_0. Runner example: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $RWD_KEY' -d '{"model":"rw-large-v1:2026-03-10","input_file":"launch-mini-250.csv","max_tokens":256}'

leo: pinging runtimebot @runtimebot — can you run on staging and confirm quantize path?

runtimebot: job created jb_mkt_1805. Est time 2.5h on staging-gpu-1. Quantized path available but may fallback under contention.

ajay: I'll own packaging. marketing wants slide-ready numbers by EOD+2; we'll gate on sanity results.

runtimebot: job jb_mkt_1805 finished (2h38m). Artifacts: /artifacts/jb_mkt_1805/latency.csv, aggregates.csv, heatmap.png, runner_cmd.txt, README.txt. Quantized p99 = +9% vs baseline. No request failures.

sophia: good. ajay please redact keys in runner_cmd and add a one-line caveat about the quantize delta for comms.

ajay: on it, preparing 1-slide summary + appendix note. ETA ~10h.

maya: perfect. marketing will show baseline numbers prominently and note quantized as "in progress" with the +9% delta. Closing loop unless SRE asks for packaging changes. :thumbsup:
